raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Regular nightly images currently contain MoK kernels for Blackwell SM100/SM103, so the same image cannot run MoK on Rubin. Build SM100a, SM103a, and SM107a kernels into each native ARM/x86 wheel by default, using the existing PyTorch 26.09 / CUDA 13.4 base.

Pin MoK to the Rubin-support change in [QiZhangNV/mixture-of-kittens#10](https://github.com/QiZhangNV/mixture-of-kittens/pull/10), based on the current integration branch. That change selects ThunderKittens device instructions separately for each GPU target. Remove Bridge's local MoK patch because its multi-target and namespace fixes already exist in the selected source; MoK owns its TK preparation patches.

The installer compiles a small kernel for every requested NVCC target before fetching/building and verifies all requested cubins in the installed wheel. `MOK_ARCH=ALL` remains the Dockerfile default; individual SM100/SM103/SM107 builds remain available. No architecture pipeline variable is needed: [nemo-ci !3018](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/dl/JoC/nemo-ci/-/merge_requests/3018) now exposes only an optional source-commit override.

Validation:
- Nine focused installer tests and three single-architecture subtests pass in a Linux CPU container. These exercise compiler rejection and missing-cubin detection with mocked build tools.
- Shell syntax and changed-source whitespace checks pass.
- `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes in the Linux container (all five Python hooks; Markdown-name hook has no matches).
- Native ARM/x86 CUDA 13.4 wheel builds pass in [pipeline 76993332](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/dl/JoC/nemo-ci/-/pipelines/76993332). Both installed extensions contain SM100a, SM103a, and SM107a cubins.
- Same-image GPU correctness passed on [GB300](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/dl/JoC/nemo-ci/-/jobs/512055599) and [Rubin](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/dl/JoC/nemo-ci/-/jobs/512055600): 16 tests passed on each of four ranks, including BF16/MXFP8 forward/all-gradient comparisons at widths 256/640 and the existing eager-dispatch cases. CI and Slurm completed successfully.
- Both GPU jobs loaded the identical ARM image digest and identical MoK extension SHA256. The intermediate `mok-wheel` image used an offline pytest-only overlay; the installed MoK package was unchanged.
- **Draft, dependent on MoK #10.** SM100 was compiled but not GPU-tested. These bounded kernel tests do not establish full-model correctness or performance parity; no published nightly tag was replaced.

@@ -15,41 +15,56 @@
 
 set -euxo pipefail
 
-MOK_REVISION="${1:?Usage: install_mok.sh <git commit> <patch> <wheel directory>}"
-PATCH_FILE=$(realpath "${2:?Usage: install_mok.sh <git commit> <patch> <wheel directory>}")
-WHEEL_DIR=$(realpath -m "${3:?Usage: install_mok.sh <git commit> <patch> <wheel directory>}")
+MOK_REVISION="${1:?Usage: install_mok.sh <git commit> <wheel directory>}"
+WHEEL_DIR=$(realpath -m "${2:?Usage: install_mok.sh <git commit> <wheel directory>}")
 PYTHON="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/opt/venv}/bin/python"
 
 if [[ ! "${MOK_REVISION}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
     echo "MOK_COMMIT must be a full Git commit" >&2
     exit 1
 fi
 
-# ALL includes both GPU architectures supported by the pinned source.
+# Each native CPU wheel contains Blackwell and Rubin kernels by default.
 export MOK_ARCH="${MOK_ARCH:-ALL}"
 case "${MOK_ARCH}" in
-    ALL) MOK_CUBINS=(sm_100a sm_103a) ;;
+    ALL) MOK_CUBINS=(sm_100a sm_103a sm_107a) ;;
     SM100) MOK_CUBINS=(sm_100a) ;;
     SM103) MOK_CUBINS=(sm_103a) ;;
+    SM107) MOK_CUBINS=(sm_107a) ;;
     *)
-        echo "Unsupported MOK_ARCH '${MOK_ARCH}'; expected ALL, SM100 or SM103" >&2
+        echo "Unsupported MOK_ARCH '${MOK_ARCH}'; expected ALL, SM100, SM103 or SM107" >&2
         exit 1
         ;;
 esac
 
+export NVCC="${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}/bin/nvcc"
+export MOK_NVCC="${NVCC}"
 WORK_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
 trap 'rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"' EXIT
 
+# Some toolkits list only base names (sm_100), even when sm_100a is supported.
+# Compile the exact gencode pairs used by MoK instead of trusting that listing.
+PROBE_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/compiler-probe"
+mkdir "${PROBE_DIR}"
+cat > "${PROBE_DIR}/arch_probe.cu" <<'CUDA'
+extern "C" __global__ void mok_arch_probe() {}
+CUDA
+for MOK_CUBIN in "${MOK_CUBINS[@]}"; do
+    if ! "${NVCC}" -cubin -gencode "arch=compute_${MOK_CUBIN#sm_},code=${MOK_CUBIN}" \
+        "${PROBE_DIR}/arch_probe.cu" -o "${PROBE_DIR}/${MOK_CUBIN}.cubin" \
+        || [[ ! -s "${PROBE_DIR}/${MOK_CUBIN}.cubin" ]]; then
+        echo "${NVCC} cannot build ${MOK_CUBIN}; use a base toolkit supporting every requested MoK target" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+done
+rm -rf "${PROBE_DIR}"
+
 git init "${WORK_DIR}"
 git -C "${WORK_DIR}" remote add origin https://github.com/QiZhangNV/mixture-of-kittens.git
 git -C "${WORK_DIR}" fetch --depth 1 origin "${MOK_REVISION}"
 git -C "${WORK_DIR}" checkout --detach "${MOK_REVISION}"
-git -C "${WORK_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}"
-git -C "${WORK_DIR}" apply "${PATCH_FILE}"
 bash "${WORK_DIR}/scripts/prepare_thunderkittens.sh"
 
-export NVCC="${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}/bin/nvcc"
-export MOK_NVCC="${NVCC}"
 # Docker builds have no GPU driver. Stubs are link inputs, never runtime libraries.
 export LIBRARY_PATH="${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}/lib64/stubs${LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LIBRARY_PATH}}"
 uv build --python "${PYTHON}" --wheel --no-build-isolation --no-cache --out-dir "${WHEEL_DIR}" "${WORK_DIR}"

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.

+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+
+"""Exercise the image installer's compiler and cubin gates without compiling CUDA."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+INSTALLER = ROOT / "docker/common/install_mok.sh"
+REVISION = "a" * 40
+TARGETS = "sm_100a\nsm_103a\nsm_107a\n"
+
+
+class TestInstallMok(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
+        self.directory = Path(self.temp.name)
+        self.bin = self.directory / "bin"
+        self.bin.mkdir()
+        self.record = self.directory / "commands.jsonl"
+        tool = self.bin / "tool"
+        tool.write_text(
+            f"#!{sys.executable}\n"
+            "import json, os, sys\n"
+            "from pathlib import Path\n"
+            "name, args = Path(sys.argv[0]).name, sys.argv[1:]\n"
+            "with open(os.environ['MOK_TEST_RECORD'], 'a') as out:\n"
+            "    out.write(json.dumps({'name': name, 'args': args, 'arch': os.environ.get('MOK_ARCH')}) + '\\n')\n"
+            "if name == 'realpath':\n"
+            "    sys.stdout.write(str(Path(args[-1]).resolve()) + '\\n')\n"
+            "elif name == 'nvcc':\n"
+            "    if args == ['--list-gpu-code']:\n"
+            "        sys.stdout.write(os.environ['MOK_TEST_LISTED_TARGETS'])\n"
+            "    else:\n"
+            "        assert len(args) == 6 and args[:2] == ['-cubin', '-gencode'] and args[4] == '-o', args\n"
+            "        target = Path(args[5]).stem\n"
+            "        assert args[2] == 'arch=compute_' + target.removeprefix('sm_') + ',code=' + target, args\n"
+            "        assert '__global__ void mok_arch_probe()' in Path(args[3]).read_text()\n"
+            "        if target not in os.environ['MOK_TEST_COMPILER_TARGETS'].split():\n"
+            "            sys.exit(1)\n"
+            "        Path(args[5]).write_bytes(b'' if os.environ.get('MOK_TEST_EMPTY_PROBE') else b'compiled cubin')\n"
+            "elif name == 'git':\n"
+            "    if args[0] == 'init':\n"
+            "        scripts = Path(args[1]) / 'scripts'\n"
+            "        scripts.mkdir(parents=True)\n"
+            "        (scripts / 'prepare_thunderkittens.sh').write_text('exit 0\\n')\n"
+            "    else:\n"
+            "        assert args[:1] == ['-C'] and args[2] in ('remote', 'fetch', 'checkout'), args\n"
+            "elif name == 'uv':\n"
+            "    if args[0] == 'build':\n"
+            "        wheels = Path(args[args.index('--out-dir') + 1])\n"
+            "        wheels.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n"
+            "        (wheels / 'mok.whl').touch()\n"
+            "    elif args[0] == 'run':\n"
+            "        sys.stdout.write('/fake/mok/_C.so')\n"
+            "    else:\n"
+            "        assert args[:2] == ['pip', 'install'], args\n"
+            "elif name == 'cuobjdump':\n"
+            "    assert args == ['--list-elf', '/fake/mok/_C.so'], args\n"
+            "    for target in os.environ['MOK_TEST_WHEEL_TARGETS'].split():\n"
+            "        sys.stdout.write('ELF file 1: kernel.' + target + '.cubin\\n')\n"
+            "else:\n"
+            "    raise AssertionError(name)\n"
+        )
+        tool.chmod(0o755)
+        for name in ("realpath", "git", "uv", "nvcc", "cuobjdump"):
+            (self.bin / name).symlink_to(tool)
+
+    def _run(self, *, revision=REVISION, **overrides):
+        self.record.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key != "MOK_ARCH"}
+        return subprocess.run(
+            ["bash", str(INSTALLER), revision, str(self.directory / "wheels")],
+            env={
+                **env,
+                "PATH": f"{self.bin}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}",
+                "CUDA_HOME": str(self.directory),
+                "MOK_TEST_RECORD": str(self.record),
+                "MOK_TEST_COMPILER_TARGETS": TARGETS,
+                "MOK_TEST_LISTED_TARGETS": "sm_100\nsm_103\nsm_107\n",
+                "MOK_TEST_WHEEL_TARGETS": TARGETS,
+                **overrides,
+            },
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=False,
+        )
+
+    def _commands(self):
+        return [json.loads(line) for line in self.record.read_text().splitlines()]
+
+    def test_default_builds_all_targets_from_exact_revision(self):
+        result = self._run()
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
+        commands = self._commands()
+        fetch = next(command for command in commands if "fetch" in command["args"])
+        self.assertEqual(fetch["args"][-4:], ["--depth", "1", "origin", REVISION])
+        build = next(command for command in commands if command["name"] == "uv" and command["args"][0] == "build")
+        self.assertEqual(build["arch"], "ALL")
+        self.assertIn("--no-build-isolation", build["args"])
+        self.assertFalse(Path(build["args"][-1]).exists(), "Temporary source must be cleaned up")
+
+    def test_each_requested_architecture_can_be_built_alone(self):
+        for arch, cubin in (("SM100", "sm_100a"), ("SM103", "sm_103a"), ("SM107", "sm_107a")):
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch):
+                result = self._run(MOK_ARCH=arch, MOK_TEST_COMPILER_TARGETS=cubin, MOK_TEST_WHEEL_TARGETS=cubin)
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
+                probes = [command for command in self._commands() if command["name"] == "nvcc"]
+                self.assertEqual(len(probes), 1)
+                self.assertEqual(probes[0]["args"][2], f"arch=compute_{cubin.removeprefix('sm_')},code={cubin}")
+
+    def test_compiles_specific_targets_when_listing_only_reports_base_names(self):
+        result = self._run()
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
+        commands = self._commands()
+        probes = [command for command in commands if command["name"] == "nvcc"]
+        self.assertEqual(len(probes), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [command["args"][2] for command in probes],
+            [f"arch=compute_{target.removeprefix('sm_')},code={target}" for target in TARGETS.split()],
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(all(command["args"][0] == "-cubin" for command in probes))
+        self.assertTrue(all(not Path(command["args"][3]).parent.exists() for command in probes))
+        first_git = next(index for index, command in enumerate(commands) if command["name"] == "git")
+        self.assertTrue(all(command["name"] != "nvcc" for command in commands[first_git:]))
+
+    def test_empty_compiler_output_fails_before_fetching_source(self):
+        result = self._run(MOK_TEST_EMPTY_PROBE="1")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertIn("cannot build sm_100a", result.stderr)
+        commands = self._commands()
+        self.assertFalse(any(command["name"] == "git" for command in commands))
+        probe = next(command for command in commands if command["name"] == "nvcc")
+        self.assertFalse(Path(probe["args"][3]).parent.exists(), "Failed probe must be cleaned up")
+
+    def test_missing_rubin_cubin_fails_default_build(self):
+        result = self._run(MOK_TEST_WHEEL_TARGETS="sm_100a sm_103a")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+
+    def test_missing_blackwell_cubin_fails_default_build(self):
+        result = self._run(MOK_TEST_WHEEL_TARGETS="sm_103a sm_107a")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+
+    def test_unsupported_compiler_fails_before_fetching_source(self):
+        result = self._run(MOK_TEST_COMPILER_TARGETS="sm_100a\nsm_103a\n")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertIn("cannot build sm_107a", result.stderr)
+        commands = self._commands()
+        self.assertFalse(any(command["name"] == "git" for command in commands))
+        probes = [command for command in commands if command["name"] == "nvcc"]
+        self.assertEqual(len(probes), 3)
+        self.assertTrue(all(not Path(command["args"][3]).parent.exists() for command in probes))
+
+    def test_unsupported_architecture_fails_before_fetching_source(self):
